Maya: Tiny challenge: share a short story or flash line (two-three sentences) + the one song you'd press play on while reading it. Keep it commute-length.

Theo: 'He left the key on the dashboard. Someone had already left a smiley drawn in the dust.' — Song: King Krule 'Easy Easy' :headphones:

Asha: 'The museum guard blinked twice and handed me the postcard with my own handwriting.' — Song: Lianne La Havas 'What You Don't Do' (soft and strange)

devon: 'I opened the umbrella and it rained the same color as my childhood shoes.' — Song: TV Girl 'Cigarettes out the Window' (cheeky, short) :umbrella:

Maya: @spotify-bot make a 12-15 min "Commute Shorts" mix with these? No extra tracks, please.

spotify-bot: Playlist created: "Commute Shorts (Maya's picks)" https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7yExample (3 tracks added) :sparkles:

Theo: also: tiny poll 1 choose one you'd actually read on a loud tram, react with :thumbsup: for the post-it mystery, :heart: for the postcard, :laughing: for the umbrella line.

Asha: I'm voting :heart: (postcard wins)

devon: :laughing: for bus giggles

Maya: Saving this thread to the watercooler board. Thanks for the micro-escape, team :coffee:
